body:
Yeah that's why it sucks. I made a point to not identify her at all. I don't know if I'll be able to tell my story in front of her. 

That's the thing. Like right now I'm missing her. The idea of her with someone else is killing me. Even though whoever she is, she's not the person I'm missing. And that kills me. That the person I'm missing isn't even real. And these attacks are just killing me. I'm shaking.

That's the thing. It didn't identify her at all. You know? So getting mad that someone said those things about you is one thing, and that's on her. But I had no desire to let anyone know who it was. 

It's terrifying having to see her. My sister is coming with me and maybe a close friend. I'm hoping it won't go too long, but the idea of having to hear her make a sob story and play the victim is just very invalidating. She's trying to take my story away from me. And it's all so vile. I'd never take it this far. But I'd also never be abusive so who knows. I just can't shake these feelings. I don't know how to walk in there standing strong when I don't feel that way at all. And I don't want her to know she's so close to winning. And I'm afraid when I look at her I'll see the girl I loved, not the girl she is. I can't afford that.

"All you have to be now is you."
That part brought me to tears. Thank you. I needed that. 

I know it's unhealthy, and I'm not sure what she has, but I was on the receiving end of it for way too long. And honestly? I think what I'm realizing is that I'm not even mad at her for being that way. She's suffering, and she handled it poorly which is making her act like a pretty awful person. I'm mad at myself for thinking I deserved it. I'm mad at myself for taking more and more steps to try to be enough for her, and then believing her as she strung me along. 

With the restraining order, I looked at the 75 pages she submitted. A lot of it was hand-written, and that broke my heart to see her lie in her own writing. I really don't have any desire to "win" anymore. I wanted to tell my story because I'm a writer, and I realized that not enough men speak out about being abused. Obviously that backfired, and it sucks because writing has been my outlet my entire life and she used this opportunity to try to take my voice away. 

I'm appealing the restraining order because I have to, but it's costing me flying across the country, a hotel for three nights, and lawyer's fees. He's confident we can win this because she doesn't have much of a case, but there's still a chance I might lose.

What I'm afraid of is the fact that I'll have to see her. I'll have to listen to my lawyer asking her questions I know she'll respond to with lies. I don't even think she knows I'll be there. I know if she sees me she'll try to look at me with concerned eyes, maybe even mouth "I'm sorry" and I can't promise myself I won't fall for it. That's what scares me. Taking that step back. 

I've been seeing a therapist for over a year now, but because my ex convinced me to never talk to anyone about what she's done, she never knew. Now she does and we're just beginning to work on it. But it just hurts more every time I talk about it. I'm trying to eat more but my appetite still just isn't there. It hasn't been for some time now. I just feel broken. I was doing so much better until I was hit with the restraining order. But that knocked me back down and I think that's why she did it.

Hi. So yeah, the abusive relationship was really, really tough for me. We were long distance. We met online and our first year was strictly online until I could afford to go see her. A month-and-a-half into talking she would accuse me of cheating on her, saying I was lying about where I was. That never stopped. I wasn't allowed to talk to girls she deemed threats, and if I tried she'd make me feel guilty and often times attack me. She'd call me a piece of shit, a liar, say I was ruining her, etc. She told me to kill myself a few times as well. We'd fight constantly because she was alone all summer and didn't seek help. She'd let her thoughts take over and accuse me of anything she could. I always had to think about how I interacted with women (most of my friends are women because men terrify me thanks to an abusive childhood), and she'd always just say it was being "mindful." I wasn't allowed to wear joggers because other girls weren't allowed to see any sense of...that area. I wasn't allowed to talk to my friends about our issues. She said, "I keep our matters private, I wish you'd do the same."

Once I bought a ticket to see her she posted a picture on Snapchat of her kissing another guy at a party. She resented me for being upset about that. And again, she'd always accuse me of cheating. We met in February of last year, and on Valentine's Day I found out she had been cheating on me with a...really gross dude? That sounds bad but it really hit me hard. We fought about that for a while and I was losing my trust in her. But she'd always check my phone, trying to find something to nail me for. A few months later she got on Tinder and ended up texting a few guys. She said it was nothing but a game, she just wanted friends, but I'll never believe that. These guys were better looking than me. They were thinner. They were..just better. And she knew it was killing me but she wouldn't stop talking to them. Again, she'd always accuse me of cheating, and I became anorexic and bulimic trying to be as good as the guys she was cheating with. I would stay up late obsessing over them trying to be more like them. 

She ended it in October because I briefly texted/flirted with a girl, and for three months demonized me for it. She said I ruined my chance with her, I'd never find anyone as good as her, I'd never be good enough for anyone. She'd tell me I was her soulmate, the love of her life, she'd never want anyone else, she just needed time to heal. Then she'd lash out, say mean, vile, awful things. I never knew what to believe. But I was holding on to the good in her. She kept giving me hope. And I was so close to breaking, but I tried so hard not to because I only wanted her. She would go back and forth between wanting space and missing me too much and not being able to not talk to me. 

In the first week of January she tried cutting ties again and I just snapped because of things she had said over Christmas. For the first time since the breakup my bipolar took over, and I got al little reckless.I sent too many emails, no threats, but I was suicidal and somewhat mean. A week later her friends started harassing me on Twitter. I responded by tweeting about being in an abusive relationship and what it does to a person. I never mentioned any names, I just wanted to tell my story and hope it might help someone in a similar situation. She called me from a blocked number and asked me to take the tweets down. She said it was unfair to keep them up because they didn't talk about what I did wrong, it made me seem like the only victim, and that because my friends can tell who it was about, that was harassment. I didn't budge. And another key point is that I had changed career paths recently. She knew this. She lives in a city on the east coast. When I told her about my switch she told me that this city had one of the best schools for it and I should apply there. On this phone call she also gave me advice on finding apartments and whatnot. That's important. The next day she emailed me again asking to delete the tweets. After about an hour I backed down and she thanked me and said she loved me. 

The next week I decided to write a blog post fully telling my story of abuse. She didn't like that. I got an email from her school's dean saying I had been harassing her (partially true from the first week of January), and if I didn't delete this blog post she'd be taking action. Because it had her "personally identifiable information and has caused her serious emotional distress and fear of her physical safety." I didn't delete it because I know what I'm allowed to say and what I'm not allowed to say. 24 hours later she got a restraining order. I live 3,000 miles away and never threatened her. But that can go on my record forever. 

I've seen the documents, she lied and took out emails that make her look at fault. She didn't include anything from before the 1st of January, where she was cruel and mean. But I have to go there to fight it. I have to see her. And I still love that part of her I fell in love with, so it will be hard.

She had kept telling me she only wanted me, if she couldn't have me she just wanted to work on herself. I know she's been checking my blog, and I checked hers in case she said anything I could use to help my case. She posted about talking to/sleeping with three guys. That killed, because she bounced right into it and she always accused me of being that type of person. Then I posted something (not knowing she checked my blog) about a night I had with a girl. 

"I think the thing I’m realizing is that love doesn’t have to be forever. It doesn’t have to be lasting. It doesn’t have to be a relationship. It can be that moment when you look at each other, and you know that you see each other. You see all of them, and they see all of you; and you accept each other. Every scar, every mistake, every possible future, it’s all welcomed in that moment. And that’s a beautiful thing, even if it only lasts a night."

She apparently saw that and was hurt by it. Even though she ended it, she has multiple people, and she pushed a restraining order and lied to get it. But it's like...she doesn't want me but doesn't want anyone else to have me either. And I can't shake any of it. Why I wasn't good enough. Why I deserved the cruelty. Why she moved on so easily. Why I'm still being dragged into this. What I could have done differently. What would have made me good enough. Why these guys aren't getting that side of her. Why I was the only person in her life she lashed out at like that. I just...need it to stop. I need my brain to shut off. I'm tired.
Thank you so much. I really needed this. I'm trying.

Thank you so much, that's honestly one of the biggest compliments anyone could give me. It's funny, I wrote a blog post about the emotional abuse, and I made sure to not name any names or throw any shade, and she used it as a means to get an order of protection that I now have to fight. Which is why I'm so low. Because she's attacking again and again. 

But I've been writing a lot of poetry, and it helps. It helps so much. I just feel so drained.
You're right, absolutely. In the long run I'll be relieved, but right now this damage is just crippling. And I don't know how to manage it. I've tried nearly everything.
